title: Pointwise formula for a pushforward density
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^m$, let $L:\bbr_2^m\to\bbr_2^n$ be any map, and let $z\in\bbr_2^n$. The pushforward density at $z$ is $2^n$ times the uniform mean over $y\in\bbr_2^m$ of $\rho(y)$ when $L(y)=z$, and of $0$ otherwise.
